neighbours.label: ' that' or ' which' opening a relative clause after a plural noun for things provided or developed (funds that enable, guidelines that helped); complement 'that' and the same nouns without the clause stay quiet
fire: The agency offers grants that cover most tuition.
New rules were written that limit overtime.
Applicants should read the instructions which are posted online.
Our app provides templates that save you time.
The school bought tools that help blind students read.
Engineers designed valves that reduce pressure in the line.
Nurses follow procedures which protect patients from infection.
The firm builds reports that show monthly sales.
quiet: The agency says that grants cover most tuition.
New rules were written to limit overtime.
Applicants should read the instructions online before applying.
Our app saves you time with templates.
The school thinks that tools help blind students.
Engineers hope that valves reduce pressure in the line.
Nurses know that procedures protect patients from infection.
The firm builds monthly sales reports.
